<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M+ peak at ~199 Da with a Br isotopic pattern) the molecule contains one bromine atom and has a molecular formula of C9H11Br. The ¹H NMR shows four aromatic protons (ortho‑disubstituted benzene) and two equivalent –CH₂– groups each appearing as a triplet (J ≈ 7 Hz), consistent with a phenethyl bromide fragment attached to the ring. The simplest structure that fits these data is phenethyl bromide, whose SMILES is “c1ccc(cc1)CCBr”.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccc(cc1)CCBr</final_answer>
